crates.name: editcore
crates.role: Low-level text-editor kernel: line buffer, undo/redo operation log, char-based cursor, per-language type config, grep engine, encoding/EOL IO, macros and outline parsing (a Rust port of sakura-editor architecture).
crates.summary: editcore is a dependency-light (serde + serde_json + encoding_rs + memchr + regex + optional wasmtime) editor kernel with 40 public modules. It exposes a char-semantics document model (DocLineMgr / LogicPos / LogicRange) and an operation-based undo system (Ope / OpeBlk / OpeBuf), plus stateless request/response 'command' modules (history, search_ops, edit_cmd, nav, bracket, bookmark) that the web and desktop shells call directly. It is the only crate in the workspace that owns real editing primitives; every other crate either wraps it or re-exports it.

crates.name: ide-kernel
crates.role: Session-level editing kernel that aggregates editcore's Buffer/Undo/Cursor into a single Document plus a multi-tab Session and a DocStore facade.
crates.summary: ide-kernel is the declared 'single source of truth' for editing semantics across the web, desktop and TUI shells. Document wraps editcore's DocLineMgr and OpeBuf to provide char-semantics insert/delete/backspace/newline, selection, multi-cursor, find/replace, encoding and line-ending handling, with every mutation routed through undo. DocStore is the tabbed multi-document facade used directly by both the web HTTP layer and the Tauri desktop commands.

publicModules.summary: Core document model: Pos (= LogicPos), LineEnding, Selection, Encoding, DocumentSnapshot, and the Document type (apply-style edits, caret/selection/multi-cursor, undo/redo, export_text, history_json).

crates.name: ide-shell
crates.role: Headless-able shell core: vim-like mode state machine, keymap, input buffer, AI backend trait and render backends (ratatui + web) shared by the TUI, web and desktop shells.
crates.summary: ide-shell exposes App/AppConfig, which holds a command-line InputBuffer plus an optional ide_kernel::Document for real file editing. crates.name: ide-shell-protocol
crates.role: Headless vim-like RPC kernel exposed over HTTP, WebSocket and newline-delimited stdio JSON-RPC 2.0, with an injectable AI provider trait.
crates.summary: ide-shell-protocol implements its own Buffer/Kernel types (Vec<String> lines plus a cursor, per-buffer undo/redo snapshot stacks) rather than reusing editcore or ide-kernel. Kernel::handle_rpc parses a JSON-RPC 2.0 request and dispatches on method name across 21 methods; events are pushed to subscribers over tokio mpsc. The crate's binary wires axum routes /healthz, /info, /rpc, /ws and /rpcws onto one Kernel and registers a built-in MockProvider.

callEdges.note: ide_kernel::document imports editcore's DocLineMgr, LogicPos/LogicRange and the Ope/OpeBlk/OpeBuf undo types, making editcore the only owner of editing primitives (crates/ide-kernel/src/document.rs:13-15).

Document::insert/delete_range/backspace/delete_forward/newline/type_char and undo/redo delegate to the editcore DocLineMgr and OpeBuf; doc_store.rs:166 also constructs editcore::cursor::LogicRange directly.

ide_shell::App holds an Option<ide_kernel::document::Document> (crates/ide-shell/src/app.rs:12, :40); open_file builds it via Document::new/set_text/set_path/set_caret (:177-187) and save_file reads doc.export_text() (:197).
AppConfig::default formats the banner from ide_kernel_core::version() and ide_kernel_core::kernel_status() (crates/ide-shell/src/app.rs:21-25).

ide-shell has zero direct editcore references (recursive grep over crates/ide-shell/src returns none); it reaches editing semantics only through ide-kernel. Documented as intended at crates/ide-shell/Cargo.toml.

The web server imports ide_shell::render::web::{render as render_web, WebFrame} and ide_shell::{App, AppConfig} (crates/ide-shell-web/src/lib.rs:38-39); ShellState::frame() calls render_web(&app) (:92), key() calls app.on_key (:146) and mouse() calls app.on_mouse (:165).

ide_shell_web::doc_api re-exports ide_kernel::doc_store::{DocStore, DocView, FindHit, ReplaceStat} (crates/ide-shell-web/src/doc_api.rs:10) and lib.rs:42 imports ide_kernel::document::LineEnding; the /api/doc/* route arms (lib.rs:400-668) operate on that DocStore.

Stateless editcore command endpoints in the route table: edit_cmd::run (lib.rs:684), bracket::find_pair (:699), bookmark::run (:709), search_ops::run (:719), history::run (:729), nav::step (:739), edit_ops::transform_text (:757), edit_ops::transform_lines (:776), document_io::reinterpret_text (:797), theme_luminance::detect (:1259).

ShellState::kernel_banner() composes the string from ide_kernel_core::version() and ide_kernel_core::kernel_status() (crates/ide-shell-web/src/lib.rs:189-195), surfaced by GET /api/kernel_banner (lib.rs:1233).

File IO path: path_safety::read_file_enc calls editcore::document_io::read_doc (crates/ide-shell-web/src/path_safety.rs:171) and write_file_spec calls editcore::document_io::write_doc (path_safety.rs:199).

Two outbound process edges: the SCM facade shells out to git (crates/ide-shell-web/src/scm.rs) and terminal::create spawns a shell process (crates/ide-shell-web/src/terminal.rs:46). These are runtime process edges, not Rust call edges.

The desktop crate imports ide_shell::render::web::{render as render_web, WebFrame} and ide_shell::{App, AppConfig, Mode} (crates/ide-shell-desktop/src/lib.rs:76-77); the frame/reset/key/mouse Tauri commands drive that same App.

ide_shell_desktop::doc imports ide_kernel::doc_store::{DocStore, DocView, FindHit, ReplaceStat} (crates/ide-shell-desktop/src/doc.rs:18) and ide_kernel::document::{LineEnding, Encoding} (:231, :246); the 26 doc_* Tauri commands are thin wrappers over that DocStore.

Stateless desktop commands call editcore directly: edit_cmd::run (lib.rs:736), bracket::find_pair (:744), bookmark::run (:753), search_ops::run (:761), history::run (:769), nav::step (:777), edit_ops::transform_text (:794), transform_lines (:808), migemo::expand_pattern (:821), document_io::reinterpret_text (:726-727), theme_luminance::apply_backdrop_sample (:54), grep_engine::search (search.rs:20), plugin::load_and_run (plugin.rs:22).

The desktop SCM module shells out to git via run_git (crates/ide-shell-desktop/src/scm.rs:66) and the terminal module spawns shell processes (crates/ide-shell-desktop/src/terminal.rs:224 spawn_reader).

Cargo.toml declares ide-kernel-core as a path dependency (crates/ide-shell-protocol/Cargo.toml), but a recursive grep over crates/ide-shell-protocol/src finds zero source references to ide_kernel_core. The declared edge is not exercised by code.

ide-shell-protocol does NOT depend on editcore: it implements its own Buffer type over Vec<String> lines with its own undo_stack/redo_stack of BufferSnapshot (crates/ide-shell-protocol/src/lib.rs:36-48, :196-235). The protocol kernel and the product kernel are separate editing semantics.

The server binary consumes the library: ide_shell_protocol::Kernel is constructed at bin/ide-shell-protocol-server.rs:70 and Kernel::handle_rpc is invoked from the stdio loop (:106), the HTTP handler (:152), the one-way WS (:189) and the bidirectional WS (:231).

Event push path: Kernel::emit (lib.rs:474) fans an Event out to every subscriber; handle_ws (:164-181) and handle_rpc_ws (:211-243) serialize each Event to the socket as JSON. This is a WebSocket push, not SSE — recorded here as the closest available edge type.

AI injection: Kernel::register_provider (:849) stores an Arc<dyn AiProvider>; complete_at_cursor (:768), edit_via_provider (:796) and chat (:835) call the first registered provider. The RPC surface cannot register a provider — dispatch returns the error "register_provider is in-process only" (lib.rs:1130-1133).

ide-cli depends on the aci-emitter git dependency (rev df28c56, declared at Cargo.toml:46) and uses AciEmitter::new(Layer::It), em.build(...) and em.to_json(...) at crates/ide-cli/src/lib.rs:81, :101, :116.

ide-shell also depends on aci-emitter and emits a smoke assertion in App::help_text (crates/ide-shell/src/app.rs:510-530). The built assertion is discarded (`let _ = assertion;` at :531), so it proves the bridge is callable but produces no emitted artifact.

ide-shell-web declares aci-emitter as a workspace dependency but has zero source references to it (recursive grep over crates/ide-shell-web/src). The dependency is declared and unused — unlike ide-cli and ide-shell, which really do emit.

keyTypes.name: editcore::buffer::DocLineMgr
keyTypes.summary: The physical/logical line store: owns DocLine entries plus a caret LogicPos, and provides insert_str / remove_range / backspace / delete / extract_text as the only mutation primitives.

keyTypes.name: editcore::undo::OpeBuf
keyTypes.summary: Bounded undo/redo stack over OpeBlk blocks with cursor(), can_undo/can_redo, is_modified, mark_saved, push, undo, redo and JSON history serialization.

keyTypes.name: editcore::cursor::LogicPos / LogicRange
keyTypes.summary: Char-based (not byte-based) position and range types — the shared currency of every position value across editcore, ide-kernel and the shells.

keyTypes.name: editcore::type_config::TypeConfig / TypeRegistry
keyTypes.summary: Per-language keyword/comment/delim configuration with a line tokenizer (highlight_line) and a registry that detects a language from a file path (detect).

keyTypes.name: editcore::document_io::Charset / Bom / Eol / WriteSpec
keyTypes.summary: The encoding/BOM/EOL model plus read_doc / write_doc / decode_document / encode_document / reinterpret_text — the only sanctioned file-read path in the workspace.

keyTypes.name: ide_kernel::document::Document
keyTypes.summary: Session-level single document wrapping DocLineMgr + OpeBuf: caret/selection/multi-cursor, insert/delete/backspace/newline/type_char, find-replace options, encoding and line-ending, undo/redo and export_text.

keyTypes.name: ide_kernel::doc_store::DocStore
keyTypes.summary: Multi-tab document facade used identically by the web HTTP layer and the Tauri desktop commands; every method returns Option<DocView> (None = no active document).

keyTypes.name: ide_kernel::text_ops::FindOptions / FindResult
keyTypes.summary: Char-position find options (case_sensitive, regex, wrap, within_selection) and the match range type; regex mode currently degrades to literal matching by design.

keyTypes.name: ide_shell::app::App
keyTypes.summary: Top-level shell state: vim mode, a command InputBuffer, an optional kernel Document, command history, an AI backend and a quit flag; on_key/on_mouse are the shared entry points for TUI, web and desktop.

keyTypes.name: ide_shell::render::web::WebFrame
keyTypes.summary: Serializable frame model (cells, styles, mode) produced by render(app) — the single render output consumed by both the web HTTP /api/frame route and the Tauri frame command.

keyTypes.name: ide_shell_web::ShellState
keyTypes.summary: The web server's single-user state: Mutex<App>, Auth, Mutex<DocStore> and an optional project root; frame/key/mouse/reset/project_root_set are the state operations the route table drives.

keyTypes.name: ide_shell_web::auth::Auth
keyTypes.summary: Per-boot CSPRNG token with host/origin allow-listing; Auth::check runs before any request body is allocated, and origin_is_allowed drives the echo-only CORS policy.

keyTypes.name: ide_shell_protocol::Buffer / Kernel
keyTypes.summary: The protocol crate's own parallel editing model: Vec<String> lines, char cursor, per-buffer undo_stack/redo_stack of BufferSnapshot, and a Kernel owning buffers, providers and event subscribers.

keyTypes.name: ide_shell_protocol::AiProvider
keyTypes.summary: The AI integration trait (complete / edit / chat), async, implemented by the binary's MockProvider and injectable only in-process.

keyTypes.name: ide_shell_protocol::RpcRequest / RpcResponse / RpcError
keyTypes.summary: JSON-RPC 2.0 envelope shared by stdio, HTTP POST /rpc and both WebSocket endpoints; a null id marks a notification and suppresses the reply.

keyTypes.name: ide_shell_protocol::Event
keyTypes.summary: Tagged event enum (BufferOpened/Changed/Closed, ModeChanged, ActiveBufferChanged, ProviderRegistered/Unregistered) pushed to subscribers and serialized to WebSocket clients.

keyTypes.name: ide_shell_desktop::ProjectRoot
keyTypes.summary: Tauri-managed state holding the currently opened project root, which bounds every file operation performed by the list_dir / read_file / write_file commands.

keyTypes.name: ide_shell_desktop::doc::DocState
keyTypes.summary: Tauri-managed wrapper around ide_kernel::doc_store::DocStore — the desktop counterpart of the web crate's doc_api DocStore instance.

errorAndRetry.errorKind: HTTP 431 Request Header Fields Too Large (header byte budget MAX_HEADER_BYTES = 16 KB)
errorAndRetry.retryPolicy: None — server rejects and closes the connection; client must not blindly retry.

errorAndRetry.errorKind: AuthError from auth.check (bad token / disallowed Host / disallowed Origin), returned as the error status with a JSON {"error": ...} body
errorAndRetry.retryPolicy: None — a rejected auth is terminal; retrying with the same credentials cannot succeed.

errorAndRetry.errorKind: HTTP 413 Payload Too Large (body byte budget MAX_BODY_BYTES = 8 MB)
errorAndRetry.retryPolicy: None — reject; a smaller request is required.

errorAndRetry.errorKind: send_error_json wraps every business failure as application/json {"error": reason} so clients can always call .json()
errorAndRetry.retryPolicy: Uniform error contract — no per-endpoint retry hint is emitted.

errorAndRetry.errorKind: doc_respond maps a None result to HTTP 404 with {"ok": false, "error": "no active document"}
errorAndRetry.retryPolicy: Caller must open a document first; retrying unchanged yields the same 404.

errorAndRetry.errorKind: path_within / resolve_in_project reject targets escaping the project root; write failures are prefixed "写入失败"
READ_TIMEOUT_SECS = 15 read timeout guarding a half-open connection on the single-threaded hand-written server
errorAndRetry.retryPolicy: Server-side disconnect after 15s of an incomplete request; client may retry the whole request.

errorAndRetry.errorKind: codes::PARSE_ERROR (-32700) on malformed JSON, codes::INVALID_REQUEST (-32600) when jsonrpc != "2.0"
errorAndRetry.retryPolicy: None — the request itself is malformed.

errorAndRetry.errorKind: Error-code mapping from the error string: "not found" -> BUFFER_NOT_FOUND (-32001), "method" -> METHOD_NOT_FOUND (-32601), otherwise INVALID_PARAMS (-32602)
errorAndRetry.retryPolicy: String-substring based classification — brittle but explicit; no automatic retry.

errorAndRetry.errorKind: "no provider registered" / "no provider" when the provider registry is empty
errorAndRetry.retryPolicy: None until a provider is registered in-process.

errorAndRetry.errorKind: "register_provider is in-process only. Use setup() to bind a provider at startup."
errorAndRetry.retryPolicy: Not retryable over RPC — provider must be bound by the embedding process.

errorAndRetry.errorKind: ProtocolError enum: Io(#[from] std::io::Error), Json(#[from] serde_json::Error), InvalidRequest(String)
errorAndRetry.retryPolicy: Declared error type for the crate; no retry policy is encoded.

errorAndRetry.errorKind: Mutation methods clamp the target position (clamp_pos) instead of failing, so out-of-range edits are silently corrected rather than rejected
errorAndRetry.retryPolicy: n/a — edits always succeed with a clamped caret.

errorAndRetry.errorKind: Every mutating method returns Option<DocView>; None signals 'no active document' or 'unknown tab id'
errorAndRetry.retryPolicy: Caller must open/activate a tab first.

errorAndRetry.errorKind: open_file rejects files over 4 MB and non-UTF-8 content with "读取失败 (仅支持 UTF-8)"; save_file reports "没有打开的文件" / "文档没有路径" / "写入失败: {e}"
errorAndRetry.retryPolicy: None — the size and encoding limits are deterministic.

errorAndRetry.errorKind: PluginError::WasmUnavailable when the optional 'wasm' feature is off (the workspace default)
errorAndRetry.retryPolicy: Not retryable at runtime — requires recompiling with the wasm feature.

errorAndRetry.errorKind: BackupError enum with Display + Error impls and a From<std::io::Error> conversion
errorAndRetry.retryPolicy: Declared error type; no retry policy encoded.

errorAndRetry.errorKind: io::Result from try_lock(target, wait) — lock contention surfaces as an io error; the optional wait duration governs the retry window
errorAndRetry.retryPolicy: try_lock accepts an explicit wait Duration, which is the only retry knob in the workspace.

errorAndRetry.errorKind: aci-emitter build validation error printed as "validation error: {e}" with exit code 2; a serde serialization failure prints "serialize error: {e}"
errorAndRetry.retryPolicy: None — the emitted assertion is a fixed placeholder payload.

evidence.summary: editcore::buffer exposes DocLine (20) and DocLineMgr (115) with real insert_str/remove_range/backspace/delete/extract_text implementations operating on char positions.
editcore::undo implements EOpeCode (25), Ope with apply/undo (40, 68, 94), OpeBlk (128) and OpeBuf with push/undo/redo/history_json/from_json (168-268).
editcore::cursor defines LogicPos (15) and LogicRange (47) as char-based position types with ZERO const, compare and normalize.
editcore::type_config defines TokenKind (20), OutlineEntry (97), TypeConfig (150) with highlight_line (345), and TypeRegistry (456) with detect (561) and register/unregister (594, 604).
editcore::document_io implements detect_charset (204), decode_document (309), encode_document (332), read_doc (436), write_doc (458) and reinterpret_text (490) over the Charset/Bom/Eol model.
ide_kernel::document imports editcore::buffer::DocLineMgr, editcore::cursor::{LogicPos, LogicRange} and editcore::undo::{EOpeCode, Ope, OpeBlk, OpeBuf} and implements Document (181) on top of them.

ide_kernel::doc_store::DocStore (61) implements the tabbed facade: open/active/tabs/activate/close, insert/type/newline/backspace/delete/delete_range, caret/selection, undo/redo, multi-cursor, find/find_all/replace_all, line_ending/encoding/export/mark_saved.
ide_kernel::text_ops defines FindOptions (12) and FindResult (36) and matches within a single line by char position; the regex option explicitly degrades to literal matching (comment at :59).
ide-kernel-core implements only version() (29) and kernel_status() (41, returning the literal "placeholder"); its module docs mark the crate a Stage 3.0 placeholder pending DD-01..DD-04.
ide_shell::App holds Option<ide_kernel::document::Document> (40); open_file (164) constructs and positions it, save_file (194) exports it via doc.export_text().
ide_shell::render::web defines WebCell (20), WebStyle (26), WebFrame (62) and pub fn render(app) -> WebFrame (240) — the shared render for web HTTP and Tauri.
ide_shell_web::ShellState (51) owns Mutex<App>, auth::Auth, Mutex<doc_api::DocStore> and an optional project root; frame/key/mouse/reset/project_root_set are implemented methods on it.

Declared-but-unused dependency: ide-shell-protocol declares ide-kernel-core in Cargo.toml but has zero source references to it.

Architectural split: two independent editing semantics exist. ide-kernel (over editcore's DocLineMgr/OpeBuf, char-based) backs the web and desktop product path; ide-shell-protocol implements its own Buffer over Vec<String> lines with snapshot-based undo and is used by none of the product shells. The two are not reconciled in the code read.

Architectural split: the web and desktop crates call editcore's stateless command modules directly (search_ops, history, edit_cmd, nav, bracket, bookmark, edit_ops) in addition to going through ide-kernel's DocStore. The 'single source of truth' claim in ide-kernel's docs therefore applies only to the stateful document path, not to the stateless command endpoints.
The editcore crate's own module doc (lib.rs:6) claims 'no regex crate', but Cargo.toml declares regex = "1" and search_ops uses it. The doc comment is stale.

The web server is a hand-written single-threaded HTTP/1.1 implementation (no axum), with a 15s read timeout, a 16 KB header cap and an 8 MB body cap; the protocol server uses axum instead. The two HTTP servers have completely different routing models (match on (method, path) vs axum Router).
IDE_SHELL_WEB_NO_AUTH (auth.rs:69) is the documented escape hatch that disables authentication; any deployment using it exposes /api/terminal_* which is an RCE surface.
All cargo build/test commands were deliberately NOT run per task scope, so 'Implemented' in this file means 'a real implementation body exists at the cited lines', not 'the crate compiles'.

The worktree at capture time contained many untracked files with shell-mangled names (e.g. '99', 'bar', '(0', 'len)') at the repository root, plus untracked .atlas-work/ and .serena/ directories. These are untracked and are not part of REV-IDE1.
